## Privacy and dependencies

Describe any data-handling or dependency change. Exclude credentials, private URLs, device IDs, personal logs, and private library data.

## Handoff

Record blockers, remaining work, and the next concrete action. Owner authorization is required for merge/promotion; leave the PR in draft when implementation checks or scope remain unresolved.
